rawText: DEMO FIXTURE — not a live tender. Enterprise network operations across Gujarat. The bidder shall have average annual turnover of at least Rs. 1 crore during the last three financial years. The bidder shall have at least 5 years of relevant enterprise network experience. The bidder shall hold a current ISO 27001 certificate. The bidder shall maintain a registered office in Gujarat. EMD is Rs. 25,00,000. Bids close on 30 November 2026 at 15:30 IST.
